title: One gym can fill the shared database through record saving, with no total limit or speed limit
what: Each save of gym records may carry up to 1,000 records of up to 20 KB each, about 20 MB in one go. Nothing limits how often a gym saves, and nothing limits how much one gym keeps in total. Removed records also stay on the server. Any owner key may do this, including the key a demo gym gets with no sign-up. A broken device or a misuser could fill the free 500 MB database that every gym shares, and then every desk stops saving.
expected: Each gym has a total size budget and a limit on saves per minute, with a warning to MettleUp as a gym nears its budget.
fix_line: Give each gym a size budget and a save speed limit, and warn MettleUp before a gym reaches it

title: Receipt change history and old sign-ins are never cleared, so they grow for ever
what: Every change to a receipt keeps two full copies of it, before and after, with no time limit and no cap per gym. A device that saves all its receipts again adds a pair for each one. Ended and old panel sign-ins are also kept for good. The nightly clean-up removes old access logs, support rows and audit rows, but not these. Both keep eating the shared free database.
expected: A stated keep time for receipt history and ended sign-ins, cleared by the nightly clean-up, or a size cap per gym.
fix_line: Add receipt history and ended sign-ins to the nightly clean-up with a keep time
